description: TypeScript source as the TypeScript lane reads it: which files are a test's, not the application's.

rules.description: A file in a directory with one of these names, or whose name ends in one of these endings, is test support: a spec, a mock, a stub or a helper only a test runs. The TypeScript lane leaves it out, whether it is under the application's root or in a shared library an import reaches.
rules.why: A shared library's barrel may re-export its mocks, and ghostfolio keeps a *.service.mock.ts beside several services; read as the application's, a mock class is one more class a call through an abstract type may reach. The Java lane leaves src/test out the same way.

examples.why: a mock beside the service it stands in for
an Nx library's testing entry point
a directory is matched by its whole name
an ending, not a word anywhere in the name
